problems: The police ArcGIS incident service still requires a token; not used. The IEPR product page lists monthly releases from January 2014; only the December (year-to-date) release of each year was used, plus November 2017 (no December 2017 release posted) and September 2026 (latest). Older releases also contain police-region, precinct, month, quarter, motive-by-sex and age-by-sex tables; only the municipal table was extracted (the others are police areas without boundary files, or national).
